def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    def colsep(c): return len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1
    def rowsep(r): return len({g[r][c] for c in range(w)})==1
    scols=[c for c in range(w) if colsep(c) and any(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))]
    srows=[r for r in range(h) if rowsep(r) and any(g[r][c]!=bg for c in range(w))]
    g2=[row[:] for row in g]
    def tile_axis(g2, seps, horiz):
        n=h if horiz else w
        # interior = cols/rows strictly between first and last sep, or the block adjacent to single sep
        if len(seps)>=2:
            interior=list(range(seps[0]+1,seps[-1]))
            per=seps[-1]-seps[0]
            base=seps[0]+1
        else:
            s=seps[0]
            # which side has interior: check side with non-bg content adjacent
            left=[c for c in range(s) if not horiz and any(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))] or \
                 ([r for r in range(s) if any(g[r][c]!=bg for c in range(w))] if horiz else [])
            if left:
                interior=list(range(0,s)); base=0
                per=s+1-base if s-base==len(interior) else None
            else:
                interior=list(range(s+1,n)); base=s+1
            k=len(interior); per=k+1
        if not interior: return g2
        i0=interior[0]
        for i in range(n):
            if i in interior or i in seps: continue
            j=i0+((i-base)%per) if len(seps)>=2 else i0+((i-base)%per)
            # for single-sep case map into interior range
            j=i0+((i-base)%(k)) if len(seps)<2 else j
            if len(seps)<2:
                # single sep: shift by per toward sep side
                j=i - per if i>s else i + per if i<interior[0] else i
            for t in range(h if not horiz else w):
                if horiz: g2[i][t]=g2[j][t]
                else: g2[t][i]=g2[t][j]
        return g2
    g2=tile_axis(g2,scols,False)
    g2=tile_axis(g2,srows,True)
    return g2
